answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 55921 Country: India Title: Nikah Question: Want to know according to Shariah Law that if a married couple separate due to a domestic quarrel and do not have a contact of any kind of contact or relationship, verbal and personal for 35 years. The wife left the husband's house after the quarrel and goes to another city never to return or have any kind of contact thereafter. The question is now at this time whether the woman is in Nikah or not with her husband. Now at the death of her husband, can she come for iddah to her late husband's house or not after not being in any kind of relationship or any kind of contact with the husband for 35 years? Answer ID: 55921 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1475/1475/M=01/1436) In the question mentioned above, if the husband did not divorce his wife then the woman shall remain in his nikah as usual though they have not had any contact for a long time. If the husband died it is necessary for the woman to return to the house of the husband for the iddah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
